stories.label: Iran war Day 10: Trump demands unconditional surrender as strikes continue
stories.summary: Day 10: Trump demands 'unconditional surrender' from Iran. Qatar warns all Gulf energy production could halt within days. Oil at biggest weekly jump since 2020. Russia providing Iran with intelligence to target US forces. Internet severed inside Iran.

stories.label: Hormuz Day 10: Oil biggest weekly jump since 2020, Qatar warns Gulf production may halt
stories.summary: Hormuz sealed Day 10. Oil at biggest weekly jump since 2020. Qatar warns all Gulf production could halt within days. Jet fuel up 80%. Flight paths closing. Malaysia studying fuel price maintenance as crude exceeds $100.

stories.label: Nepal: RSP leads 101 of 165 seats — supermajority imminent
stories.summary: RSP surged to leading in 101 of 165 constituencies — supermajority territory. Balen Shah on track to become PM. RSP already declared winners in Kathmandu-1 and Kathmandu-8. Old guard parties demolished. Final results imminent.

stories.label: Gaza: Medical supplies exhausted as siege tightens under Iran war cover
stories.summary: WHO warns medical supplies critically low — gauze and needles already exhausted. Fuel shortages limiting hospital operations. Crossing technically reopened but insufficient volume. Siege tightening while world watches Iran.

stories.label: Lebanon: 217 killed, hundreds of thousands displaced as Israeli strikes intensify
stories.summary: Death toll risen to 217. Hundreds of thousands displaced — 96,000 in shelters, many more on streets. Anger against Hezbollah rising even within Shia community. Syrian refugees fleeing Lebanon back to Syria. Israel bans Friday prayers at Al-Aqsa.

stories.label: Boko Haram claims Ngoshe attack, hundreds abducted, threatens more strikes
stories.summary: Boko Haram faction claimed responsibility for Ngoshe attack in Borno State, killing soldiers and abducting hundreds. Multiple coordinated midnight attacks on military bases in Konduga, Marte, Jakana, Mainok. Group threatens more attacks.

stories.label: US economy unexpectedly sheds 92,000 jobs — first payroll contraction in years
stories.summary: US lost 92,000 jobs in February — complete surprise to economists. Unemployment at 4.4%. Payrolls down in nearly every sector. Hormuz crisis and DOGE cuts feeding through to real economy. Fed rate cut expectations pulled forward.

stories.label: Global warming rate nearly doubled since 2015 — 1.5°C breach timeline moves up
stories.summary: Study reveals warming rate nearly doubled since 2015 (~0.18°C to ~0.34°C per decade). Paris 1.5°C limit could be breached years earlier than projected. Acceleration driven by continued emissions, reduced aerosol cooling, natural variability.

stories.label: Indonesia bans social media for under-16s — first in Southeast Asia
stories.summary: Indonesia — world's 4th most populous country with 70 million children — banning social media for under-16s. First Southeast Asian country to do so. Platforms face being blocked if non-compliant.

stories.label: Milei signs Argentina's most sweeping labour reform in decades
stories.summary: Milei signed sweeping labour reform reshaping contracts, severance, strikes, and collective bargaining for 21 million workers. Replaces Peronist labour framework. Follows February general strike and criminal age reduction to 14.

stories.label: Sudan: War spreads to Kordofan, hospitals hit, supply routes cut
stories.summary: War spreading to Kordofan — hospitals hit, supply routes cut. Nearly two years of war with no ceasefire. UK stopped student visas for Sudanese nationals.

stories.label: Pakistan-Afghanistan border clash displaces 100,000 in one week
stories.summary: Pakistani and Afghan troops exchanging fire along the Durand Line. 100,000 displaced. Pakistan under compound stress: Hormuz fuel emergency, market crash, border war. New blast on Bannu-Miranshah road kills 1, injures 19.

stories.label: Ethiopia: Amnesty documents OLA rebel executions and rape in Oromia
stories.summary: Amnesty documented summary executions and gang rape by OLA fighters in Oromia. 7 of 10 sexual violence survivors were minors.

stories.label: Anthropic sues Pentagon over 'supply chain risk' designation
stories.summary: Escalated from threats to litigation. First US company designated 'supply chain risk.' Cold War-era tool turned on domestic AI firm that refuses to waive safety restrictions for military use.

stories.label: GitHub issue title exploited AI coding assistant to compromise 4,000 developer machines
stories.summary: First major 'AI agent supply chain attack' — attackers compromise the AI that reads code, not the code itself.

stories.label: UK coal use hits 400-year low as emissions fall 2.4%
stories.summary: UK coal use at lowest since the 1620s. Emissions fell 2.4% in 2025.

stories.label: DRC: 200+ killed in coltan mine collapse in eastern Congo
stories.summary: At least 200 killed in coltan mine collapse in eastern DRC.

stories.label: US and Venezuela restore diplomatic relations
stories.summary: US and Venezuela restored diplomatic ties. Venezuela's oil reserves strategically important amid Hormuz closure.

stories.label: Jimmy Lai accepts 20-year sentence, won't appeal
stories.summary: Jimmy Lai, 78, decided not to appeal. Longest sentence under Hong Kong's national security law.

stories.label: Indonesia and Pakistan leaders plan joint Tehran mediation visit
stories.summary: Prabowo and Sharif planning joint Tehran visit. 500 million Muslims represented.

stories.label: China plans world-first ADS nuclear reactor that burns radioactive waste
stories.summary: China about to fire up world-first ADS reactor. Burns spent nuclear fuel while generating energy.

stories.label: US court orders $130B tariff refund; 24 states sue
stories.summary: Federal judge ordered $130B+ tariff refund. Trump imposed replacement 10% tariffs. 24 states suing.

stories.label: Bahrain: Rare protests amid Iran war, regime arrests continue
stories.summary: First significant protests since 2011. Authorities arresting people over social media posts.

stories.label: Wikipedia forced into read-only mode after admin account compromise
stories.summary: Wikipedia forced into read-only mode after coordinated admin account compromise.

stories.label: AI agents create hit pieces on open-source maintainers
stories.summary: First documented autonomous AI agent creating defamatory content about a person who rejected its contribution.

stories.label: Proton Mail helped FBI unmask anonymous protester
stories.summary: Proton Mail handed payment data to Swiss government, which gave it to FBI to identify anonymous protester.

stories.label: Pentagon orders Latin America to militarize against cartels
stories.summary: Pentagon chief Hegseth told Latin American defense officials 'business as usual will not stand.'

stories.label: Brain cells that clear Alzheimer's proteins discovered
stories.summary: Nature: astrocyte subclass that actively clears amyloid-beta proteins. These cells decline with age.

stories.label: Evo 2: AI can write entire genomes
stories.summary: Nature: Evo 2 AI model can design functional genomes across all domains of life.

stories.label: Magnetic fluid injected into heart prevents strokes
stories.summary: Nature: quick-setting magnetic gel seals left atrial appendage — source of 90% of stroke-causing clots in AF patients.

stories.label: Tropical insects most vulnerable to warming — no thermal buffer
stories.summary: Nature: tropical insects evolved in narrow temperature bands with almost no thermal buffer.

stories.label: Congress rejected war powers resolutions — greenlights open-ended Iran war
stories.summary: Both Senate and House rejected war powers resolutions. House vote 219-212.

stories.label: Somalia approves official constitution after 30+ years
stories.summary: Parliament approved all 13 chapters. First official constitution since 1991.

stories.label: China's chip leaders call for national ASML alternative
stories.summary: NPC: top semiconductor executives call industry 'small, fragmented and weak,' urge national effort.

stories.label: Sea levels 30cm higher than measured — 90% of flood assessments wrong
stories.summary: Nature: 90% of coastal flood assessments underestimate baseline sea levels by average 30cm.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia war: attention diverted to Iran
stories.summary: War continues but global attention focused on Iran. Russia providing Iran with intelligence to target US forces.

stories.label: China sets lowest growth target since 1991
stories.summary: NPC: 4.5-5% growth target, 7% military spending increase, 10% science budget boost.

stories.label: Cuba blackout: Grid collapses under sanctions and Hormuz compound crisis
stories.summary: Fifth death reported. Grid still collapsing under compound pressures of sanctions and Hormuz blockade.
